remarks: Please submit offers by Monday 9/16/24 by 12 Noon. Welcome to this beautiful 2 bedroom and 1 bathroom unit at The Manor Association. The Manor is one of the most sought after complexes in Stamford for its close proximity to downtown, restaurants/shops, parks, playgrounds, public transportation, I-95, and houses of worship. The open layout of this unit makes it a great space for entertaining. You and your guests could not only relax on the spacious, private patio and enjoy the serenity of the courtyard, but also go for a swim in the associations in ground pool. Unit F2 has been tastefully updated with hardwood floors and tile throughout and stainless steel appliances. The bathroom has been beautifully done and boast a large walk in tile shower. Your private in unit washer and dryer are located in the laundry closet off the foyer. This unit comes with one reserved parking spot directly in front of the unit. A second car is allowed and can be parked in any of the many, always available, visitor spaces.Please submit offers by Monday 9/16/24 by 12 Noon.
